---
title: "Main analysis of the association between air pollution and arrhythmias in the city of Barcelona"
format: html
---

Data is not available due to privacy restrictions. Below is the code used for the main analysis of pollution on arrhythmias.

```{r}
#Load libraries
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(captioner)
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(ggplot2)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(flowchart)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(dlnm)
library(gnm)
library(splines)
library(ggh4x)
library(strucchange)
library(prais)
library(imputeTS)
library(gridExtra)
#Enumerate tables and figures
fig_nums <- captioner(prefix = 'Figura')
tab_nums <- captioner(prefix = 'Tabla')
```

# Flowchart

`r fig_nums("flowchart_study", "Flowchart of the patients-episodes in the study")`

```{r}
#| fig.width: 8
#| fig.height: 8

fc1 <- as_fc(N = 1397, label = "patients\nfollowed at CIED clinics") |>
  fc_filter(
    N = 493,
    label = "patients\nincluded during period 2017-2022",
    show_exc = TRUE,
    just_exc = "left",
    text_pattern_exc = "{n} {label}",
    label_exc = "excluded:\n - 901 outside the city of Barcelona\n - 3 with less than 18 years old",
    offset_exc = 0.18
  )

N_duracion <- data_ar_all |>
  filter(
    (duracion_s >= 30 & tipo_episodio == "Auriculars") |
      (duracion_s >= 10 & tipo_episodio == "Ventriculars")
  ) |>
  nrow()

sdata_ar_all <- data_ar_all |>
  filter(
    (duracion_s >= 30 & tipo_episodio == "Auriculars") |
      (duracion_s >= 10 & tipo_episodio == "Ventriculars")
  ) |>
  group_by(center, patient_id, tipo_episodio, fecha_inicio_day) |>
  summarise(
    duracion_s = sum(duracion_s),
    t_epis = unique(t_epis)
  )

fc2 <- as_fc(N = nrow(data_ar_all), label = "episodes of arrhythmia") |>
  fc_filter(
    N = N_duracion,
    label = "episodes of arrhythmia\n(atrial ≥ 30s; ventricular ≥ 10s)",
    show_exc = TRUE,
    label_exc = "short duration",
    offset_exc = 0.18
  ) |>
  fc_filter(
    N = nrow(sdata_ar_all),
    label = "daily aggregated episodes of arrhythmia",
    offset_exc = 0.18
  ) |>
  fc_filter(
    N = nrow(data_ar),
    label = "definite episodes of arrhythmia",
    show_exc = TRUE,
    label_exc = "outside follow-up",
    offset_exc = 0.18
  ) |>
  fc_split(
    N = table(data_ar$tipo_episodio),
    label = c("atrial arrhythmias", "ventricular arrhythmias")
  )

fc <- fc_stack(list(fc1, fc2), unite = TRUE) |>
  fc_theme(
    text_pattern = "{n} {label}",
    text_pattern_init = "{n} {label}",
    text_pattern_exc = "{n} {label}"
  ) |>
  fc_draw(big.mark = ",")

fc
```

# Descriptive

## Clinical information

There are `r round(sum(data_clinic$t_fup), 2)` patient-years in the study.

`r tab_nums("tab_demo", "Demographics characteristics")`

```{r}

data_clinic |>
  dplyr::select(arritmia, dictionary |> filter(tab == "demo") |> pull(var)) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = arritmia,
    statistic = all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})"
  ) |>
  add_overall() |>
  add_n() |>
  add_stat(
    fns = everything() ~ add_by_n
  ) |>
  modify_header(starts_with("add_n_stat") ~ "**N**") |>
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x |>
      dplyr::relocate(n, .after = stat_0) |>
      dplyr::relocate(add_n_stat_1, .after = stat_1) |>
      dplyr::relocate(add_n_stat_2, .after = stat_2)
  )

```

## Meteorological

`r tab_nums("ts_data_meteo", "Daily mean meteorogical data values")`

```{r}
data_meteo |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise_if(is.numeric, ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "meteo", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    meteo = factor(
      meteo,
      levels = c(
        "temperatura",
        "temperatura_maxima",
        "temperatura_nit",
        "temperatura_dia",
        "humitat_relativa",
        "pressio_atmosferica"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Temperatura",
        "Temperatura màxima",
        "Temperatura nocturna",
        "Temperatura diürna",
        "Humitat relativa",
        "Pressió atmosfèrica"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  tbl_summary(
    include = value,
    by = meteo,
    type = value ~ "continuous2",
    statistic = value ~ c("{mean} ({sd})", "{median} [{p25}; {p75}]"),
    label = value ~ "Daily value",
    missing = "always"
  )
```

# Time series

## Arrhyhthmias

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Day

`r fig_nums("data_ar_ts", "Time series of the arrhythmia episodes")`

```{r fig.width = 8}
data_plot <- data_ar |>
  group_by(tipo_episodio, fecha_inicio_day) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  tsibble::tsibble(index = fecha_inicio_day, key = c(tipo_episodio)) |>
  tsibble::fill_gaps(
    n = 0,
    .start = ymd("2017-01-01"),
    .end = ymd("2022-12-31")
  )

p <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = fecha_inicio_day, y = n)) +
  facet_wrap(~tipo_episodio) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Number") +
  expand_limits(y = 0)

ggplotly(p)
```

### Weekly

`r fig_nums("data_ar_ts_w", "Time series of the arrhythmia episodes")`

```{r fig.width = 8}
data_plot <- data_ar |>
  group_by(tipo_episodio, fecha_inicio_day) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  tsibble::tsibble(index = fecha_inicio_day, key = c(tipo_episodio)) |>
  tsibble::fill_gaps(
    n = 0,
    .start = ymd("2017-01-01"),
    .end = ymd("2022-12-31")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    week = week(fecha_inicio_day),
    year = year(fecha_inicio_day),
    week = str_glue("{year}, {week}")
  ) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(tipo_episodio, week) |>
  summarise(fecha_inicio_day = first(fecha_inicio_day), n = sum(n))


p <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = fecha_inicio_day, y = n)) +
  facet_wrap(~tipo_episodio) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(x = "Week", y = "Number") +
  theme_bw()

ggplotly(p)
```

### Month

`r fig_nums("data_ar_ts2", "Time series of the arrhythmia episodes (number and incidence)")`

```{r fig.width = 8}
# Generate one row per month in the study period
months_seq <- tibble(
  month = seq(ymd("2017-01-01"), ymd("2022-12-01"), by = "1 month")
)

# A patient contributes to a month if their follow-up window overlaps it
patients_per_month <- months_seq |>
  cross_join(
    data_clinic |> select(patient_id, fecha_inicio_seguimiento, fup_date)
  ) |>
  filter(
    fecha_inicio_seguimiento <= (month + months(1) - days(1)), # started before month ends
    fup_date >= month # still followed at month start
  ) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(n_patients = n_distinct(patient_id))

# Join with the arrhythmia counts and compute incidence
data_plot <- data_ar |>
  group_by(tipo_episodio, fecha_inicio_day) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  tsibble::tsibble(index = fecha_inicio_day, key = tipo_episodio) |>
  tsibble::fill_gaps(
    n = 0,
    .start = ymd("2017-01-01"),
    .end = ymd("2022-12-31")
  ) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    month = ymd(str_glue(
      "{year(fecha_inicio_day)}-{month(fecha_inicio_day)}-01"
    )),
    tipo_episodio = factor(
      tipo_episodio,
      levels = c("Auriculars", "Ventriculars"),
      labels = c("Atrial arrhythmias", "Ventricular arrhythmias")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(tipo_episodio, month) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(patients_per_month, by = "month") |>
  mutate(
    incidence = n / n_patients * 100 # events per 100 patients-month
  )

# --- Scale factor to map incidence onto the count axis ---
# Use the ratio of the ranges so both series fill the panel nicely
scale_factor <- max(data_plot$n, na.rm = TRUE) /
  max(data_plot$incidence, na.rm = TRUE)

p <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = month)) +
  facet_wrap(~tipo_episodio) +
  geom_point(aes(y = n), alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = n)) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = incidence * scale_factor, colour = "Incidence"),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Frequency (n)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ . / scale_factor,
      name = "Incidence (100 patient-months)"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Incidence" = "#A50F15")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(x = "Month") +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(colour = "none")

ggplotly(p)
```

`r tab_nums("descriptive_arrhythmias_ccross", "Descriptive characteristics of the case-crossover study")`

```{r}
# Calculate descriptive statistics
table_arrhythmias <- purrr::map_dfr(
  c("y_auri", "y_vent"),
  function(outcome_name) {

    df <- case_data

    # Extract outcome as a vector
    event <- df[[outcome_name]]

    # Exclude missing outcomes
    df <- df[!is.na(event), ]
    df$event <- event[!is.na(event)]

    # Identify informative strata
    strata_info <- df |>
      group_by(strata) |>
      summarise(
        informative = any(event == 1) & any(event == 0),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    tibble(
      arrhythmia = if (outcome_name == "y_auri") {
        "Auricular"
      } else {
        "Ventricular"
      },
      person_time = nrow(df),
      patients = n_distinct(df$patient_id),
      event_time = sum(df$event),
      total_strata = n_distinct(df$strata),
      informative_strata = sum(strata_info$informative)
    )
  }
)

# Create GT table
table_arrhythmias |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    arrhythmia = "Arrhythmia",
    person_time = "Person-time (days)",
    patients = "Patients",
    event_time = "Event-time (days)",
    total_strata = "Total strata",
    informative_strata = "Informative strata"
  ) |>
  fmt_integer(
    columns = c(
      person_time,
      patients,
      event_time,
      total_strata,
      informative_strata
    ),
    use_seps = TRUE
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -arrhythmia
  ) |>
  opt_row_striping()
```

Models will be adjusted by relative humidity, atmospheric pressure and mean temperature.

## Effect PM10

### Auricular arrhythmias

```{r}
scase_data <- case_data |>
  filter(!is.na(y_auri))

#8 degrees of freedom per year (seasonality), and subject/year/month strata indicators (individual variation)
dftrend <- round(as.numeric(diff(range(scase_data$date)) / 365.25 * 8))
btrend <- ns(scase_data$date, knots = equalknots(scase_data$date, dftrend - 1))
```

For the exposure response, we will choose a linear model for PM10 and a natural spline with 3 internal knots at the 10th, 75th and 90th percentiles for the meteorological variables. For the lag-response, we will choose for all variables a natural spline with 1 knot over 16 lags.

`r tab_nums("pm10_aic_auri", "AIC of the different models adjusted with more meteorological variables")`

```{r}
cb_cont <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$pm10,
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  lag = 16,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 16, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_rh <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$humitat_relativa,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 16,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 16, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_pres <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 16,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 16, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_temp <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$temperatura,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$temperatura,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 16,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 16, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

mod0 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod1 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod2 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod3 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + cb_temp + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

tibble(
  name = c(
    "Contamination",
    "+ Relative humidity",
    "+ Atmospheric pressure",
    "+ Temperature"
  ),
  mod = list(mod0, mod1, mod2, mod3)
) |>
  mutate(
    aic = map_dbl(mod, ~ .$aic)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(name, aic) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    name ~ "Model",
    aic ~ "AIC"
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    "center",
    columns = "aic"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(10)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Relative humidity"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(20)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Atmospheric pressure"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(30)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Temperature"
    )
  )
```

We will choose the model adjusted by relative humidity and atmospheric pressure as it has the lowest AIC.

```{r}
#Fit model
mod <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

#Prediction effect (PM10)
pred_cont <- crosspred(cb_cont, mod, at = seq(0, 80, by = 5), cen = 0)

#Prediction effect (Relative humidity)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_rh$predvar[which.min(pred_rh$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)

#Prediction effect (Atmospheric pressure)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_pres$predvar[which.min(pred_pres$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)
```

### Ventricular arrhythmias

```{r}
scase_data <- case_data

#8 degrees of freedom per year (seasonality), and subject/year/month strata indicators (individual variation)
dftrend <- round(as.numeric(diff(range(case_data$date)) / 365.25 * 8))
btrend <- ns(case_data$date, knots = equalknots(case_data$date, dftrend - 1))
```

For the exposure response, we will choose a linear model for PM10 and a natural spline with 3 internal knots at the 10th, 75th and 90th percentiles for the meteorological variables. For the lag-response, we will choose for all variables a natural spline with 1 knot over 7 lags. We have to take 7 lags, otherwise we can't adjust for meteorological variables.

`r tab_nums("pm10_aic_vent", "AIC of the different models adjusted with more meteorological variables")`

```{r}
cb_cont <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$pm10,
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_rh <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$humitat_relativa,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_pres <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_temp <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$temperatura,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$temperatura,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

mod0 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod1 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod2 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod3 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + cb_temp + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

tibble(
  name = c(
    "Contamination",
    "+ Relative humidity",
    "+ Atmospheric pressure",
    "+ Temperature"
  ),
  mod = list(mod0, mod1, mod2, mod3)
) |>
  mutate(
    aic = map_dbl(mod, ~ .$aic)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(name, aic) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    name ~ "Model",
    aic ~ "AIC"
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    "center",
    columns = "aic"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(10)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Relative humidity"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(20)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Atmospheric pressure"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(30)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Temperature"
    )
  )
```

We will choose the model adjusted by relative humidity and atmospheric pressure as it has the lowest AIC.

```{r}
#Fit model
mod <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

#Prediction effect (PM10)
pred_cont <- crosspred(cb_cont, mod, at = seq(0, 80, by = 5), cen = 0)

#Prediction effect (Relative humidity)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_rh$predvar[which.min(pred_rh$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)

#Prediction effect (Atmospheric pressure)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_pres$predvar[which.min(pred_pres$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)
```

### Ventricular arrhythmias

```{r}
scase_data <- case_data

#8 degrees of freedom per year (seasonality), and subject/year/month strata indicators (individual variation)
dftrend <- round(as.numeric(diff(range(case_data$date)) / 365.25 * 8))
btrend <- ns(case_data$date, knots = equalknots(case_data$date, dftrend - 1))
```

For the exposure response, we will choose a linear model for PM2.5 and a natural spline with 3 internal knots at the 10th, 75th and 90th percentiles for the meteorological variables. For the lag-response, we will choose for all variables a natural spline with 1 knot over 10 lags.

`r tab_nums("pm25_aic_vent", "AIC of the different models adjusted with more meteorological variables")`

```{r}
cb_cont <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$pm25,
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  lag = 10,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 10, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_rh <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$humitat_relativa,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 10,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 10, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_pres <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 10,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 10, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_temp <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$temperatura,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$temperatura,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 10,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 10, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

mod0 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod1 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod2 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod3 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + cb_temp + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

tibble(
  name = c(
    "Contamination",
    "+ Relative humidity",
    "+ Atmospheric pressure",
    "+ Temperature"
  ),
  mod = list(mod0, mod1, mod2, mod3)
) |>
  mutate(
    aic = map_dbl(mod, ~ .$aic)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(name, aic) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    name ~ "Model",
    aic ~ "AIC"
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    "center",
    columns = "aic"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(10)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Relative humidity"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(20)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Atmospheric pressure"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(30)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Temperature"
    )
  )
```

We will choose the model adjusted by relative humidity and atmospheric pressure as it has the lowest AIC.

```{r}
#Fit model
mod <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

#Prediction effect (PM2.5)
pred_cont <- crosspred(cb_cont, mod, at = seq(0, 80, by = 5), cen = 0)

#Prediction effect (Relative humidity)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_rh$predvar[which.min(pred_rh$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)

#Prediction effect (Atmospheric pressure)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_pres$predvar[which.min(pred_pres$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)
```

```{r}
  tibble::column_to_rownames("rowname") |>
  gt(rownames_to_stub = TRUE)
```

### Ventricular arrhythmias

```{r}
scase_data <- case_data

#8 degrees of freedom per year (seasonality), and subject/year/month strata indicators (individual variation)
dftrend <- round(as.numeric(diff(range(case_data$date)) / 365.25 * 8))
btrend <- ns(case_data$date, knots = equalknots(case_data$date, dftrend - 1))
```

For the exposure response, we will choose a linear model for NO2 and a natural spline with 3 internal knots at the 10th, 75th and 90th percentiles for the meteorological variables. For the lag-response, we will choose a natural spline with 3 equally spaced knots in the log scale for NO2 and 1 knot for the other meteorological variables, over 7 lags.

`r tab_nums("no2_aic_vent", "AIC of the different models adjusted with more meteorological variables")`

```{r}
cb_cont <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$no2,
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 3)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_rh <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$humitat_relativa,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_pres <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_temp <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$temperatura,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$temperatura,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

mod0 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod1 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod2 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod3 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + cb_temp + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

tibble(
  name = c(
    "Contamination",
    "+ Relative humidity",
    "+ Atmospheric pressure",
    "+ Temperature"
  ),
  mod = list(mod0, mod1, mod2, mod3)
) |>
  mutate(
    aic = map_dbl(mod, ~ .$aic)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(name, aic) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    name ~ "Model",
    aic ~ "AIC"
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    "center",
    columns = "aic"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(10)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Relative humidity"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(20)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Atmospheric pressure"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(30)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Temperature"
    )
  )
```

We will choose the model adjusted by relative humidity and atmospheric pressure as it has the lowest AIC.

```{r}
#Fit model
mod <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

#Prediction effect (NO2)
pred_cont <- crosspred(cb_cont, mod, at = seq(0, 80, by = 5), cen = 0)

#Prediction effect (Relative humidity)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_rh$predvar[which.min(pred_rh$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)

#Prediction effect (Atmospheric pressure)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_pres$predvar[which.min(pred_pres$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)

```

`r fig_nums("crosspred_no2_vent", "NO2: Overall cumulative exposure-response for each value and lag-response for a 10 ppb increase, compared to a 0 exposure (y-axis is presented in logarithmic scale).")`

```{r fig.width = 9}
  main = "Overall",
  log = "y"
)

)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
      )

  )
```

We will choose the model adjusted by relative humidity and atmospheric pressure as it has the lowest AIC.

```{r}
#Fit model
mod <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

#Prediction effect (O3)

#Prediction effect (Relative humidity)

  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_rh$predvar[which.min(pred_rh$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)

#Prediction effect (Atmospheric pressure)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_pres$predvar[which.min(pred_pres$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)
```

## Effect SO2

### Auricular arrhythmias

```{r}
scase_data <- case_data |>
  filter(!is.na(y_auri))

#8 degrees of freedom per year (seasonality), and subject/year/month strata indicators (individual variation)
dftrend <- round(as.numeric(diff(range(scase_data$date)) / 365.25 * 8))
btrend <- ns(scase_data$date, knots = equalknots(scase_data$date, dftrend - 1))
```

For the exposure response, we will choose a linear model for SO2 and a natural spline with 3 internal knots at the 10th, 75th and 90th percentiles for the meteorological variables. For the lag-response, we will choose a natural spline with 1 knot for all variables over 7 lags.

`r tab_nums("so2_aic_auri", "AIC of the different models adjusted with more meteorological variables")`

```{r}
cb_cont <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$so2,
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_rh <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$humitat_relativa,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_pres <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_temp <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$temperatura,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$temperatura,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

mod0 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod1 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod2 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod3 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + cb_temp + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

tibble(
  name = c(
    "Contamination",
    "+ Relative humidity",
    "+ Atmospheric pressure",
    "+ Temperature"
  ),
  mod = list(mod0, mod1, mod2, mod3)
) |>
  mutate(
    aic = map_dbl(mod, ~ .$aic)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(name, aic) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    name ~ "Model",
    aic ~ "AIC"
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    "center",
    columns = "aic"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(10)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Relative humidity"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(20)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Atmospheric pressure"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(30)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Temperature"
    )
  )
```

We will choose the model adjusted by relative humidity and atmospheric pressure as it has the lowest AIC.


### Auricular arrhythmias (sensitivity)

### Ventricular arrhythmias

We have to exclude data previous to 2019 as the year 2018 contains many missings and otherwise models don't converge. 

```{r}
scase_data <- case_data |>
  filter(year(date) > 2018)

#8 degrees of freedom per year (seasonality), and subject/year/month strata indicators (individual variation)
dftrend <- round(as.numeric(diff(range(scase_data$date)) / 365.25 * 8))
btrend <- ns(scase_data$date, knots = equalknots(scase_data$date, dftrend - 1))
```

For the exposure response, we will choose a linear model for SO2 and a natural spline with 3 internal knots at the 10th, 75th and 90th percentiles for the meteorological variables.  For the lag-response, we will choose a natural spline with 3 equally spaced knots in the log scale for SO2 and 1 knot for the other meteorological variables, over 7 lags. We have to take 7 lags otherwise we can't adjust for meteorological variables.

`r tab_nums("so2_aic_vent", "AIC of the different models adjusted with more meteorological variables")`

```{r}
cb_cont <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$so2,
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 3)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_rh <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$humitat_relativa,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_pres <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_temp <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$temperatura,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$temperatura,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 7,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 7, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

mod0 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod1 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod2 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod3 <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + cb_temp + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

tibble(
  name = c(
    "Contamination",
    "+ Relative humidity",
    "+ Atmospheric pressure",
    "+ Temperature"
  ),
  mod = list(mod0, mod1, mod2, mod3)
) |>
  mutate(
    aic = map_dbl(mod, ~ .$aic)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(name, aic) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    name ~ "Model",
    aic ~ "AIC"
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    "center",
    columns = "aic"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(10)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Relative humidity"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(20)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Atmospheric pressure"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(30)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Temperature"
    )
  )
```

We will choose the model adjusted by relative humidity, atmospheric pressure and temperature as it has the lowest AIC.

```{r}
#Fit model
mod <- gnm(
  y_vent ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + cb_temp + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

#Prediction effect (SO2)
pred_cont <- crosspred(cb_cont, mod, at = seq(0, 8, by = 1), cen = 0)

#Prediction effect (Relative humidity)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_rh$predvar[which.min(pred_rh$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)

#Prediction effect (Atmospheric pressure)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_pres$predvar[which.min(pred_pres$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)

#Prediction effect (Temperature)
predval <- quantile(scase_data$temperatura, probs = (1:99) / 100, na.rm = TRUE)
pred_temp <- crosspred(cb_temp, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_temp$predvar[which.min(pred_temp$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_temp <- crosspred(cb_temp, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)
```

## Effect CO

### Auricular arrhythmias

```{r}
scase_data <- case_data |>
  filter(!is.na(y_auri))

#8 degrees of freedom per year (seasonality), and subject/year/month strata indicators (individual variation)

btrend <- ns(scase_data$date, knots = equalknots(scase_data$date, dftrend - 1))
```

For the exposure response, we will choose a linear model for CO and a natural spline with 3 internal knots at the 10th, 75th and 90th percentiles for the meteorological variables. For the lag-response, we will choose a natural spline with 1 knot for all variables over 14 lags.

### Auricular arrhythmias (sensitivity analysis)

As a sensititivity analysis, we will exclude data previous to 2019 as the year 2018 contains many missings.

```{r}
scase_data <- case_data |>
  filter(!is.na(y_auri), year(date) > 2018)

#8 degrees of freedom per year (seasonality), and subject/year/month strata indicators (individual variation)
dftrend <- round(as.numeric(diff(range(scase_data$date)) / 365.25 * 8))
btrend <- ns(scase_data$date, knots = equalknots(scase_data$date, dftrend - 1))
```

For the exposure response, we will choose a linear model for CO and a natural spline with 3 internal knots at the 10th, 75th and 90th percentiles for the meteorological variables. For the lag-response, we will choose a natural spline with 1 knot for all variables over 14 lags.

`r tab_nums("co_aic_auri", "AIC of the different models adjusted with more meteorological variables")`

```{r}
cb_cont <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$co,
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  lag = 14,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 14, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_rh <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$humitat_relativa,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 14,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 14, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_pres <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 14,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 14, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

cb_temp <- crossbasis(
  scase_data$temperatura,
  argvar = list(
    fun = "ns",
    knots = quantile(
      scase_data$temperatura,
      probs = c(0.1, 0.75, 0.9),
      na.rm = T
    ),
    int = F
  ),
  lag = 14,
  arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = logknots(x = 14, nk = 1)),
  group = scase_data$patient_id
)

mod0 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod1 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod2 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

mod3 <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + cb_temp + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

tibble(
  name = c(
    "Contamination",
    "+ Relative humidity",
    "+ Atmospheric pressure",
    "+ Temperature"
  ),
  mod = list(mod0, mod1, mod2, mod3)
) |>
  mutate(
    aic = map_dbl(mod, ~ .$aic)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(name, aic) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    name ~ "Model",
    aic ~ "AIC"
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    "center",
    columns = "aic"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(10)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Relative humidity"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(20)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Atmospheric pressure"
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(30)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = name,
      rows = name == "+ Temperature"
    )
  )
```

We will choose the model adjusted by relative humidity and atmospheric pressure as it has the lowest AIC.

```{r}
#Fit model
mod <- gnm(
  y_auri ~ cb_cont + cb_rh + cb_pres + btrend + dow + fest,
  eliminate = strata,
  data = scase_data,
  family = binomial
)

#Prediction effect (CO)
pred_cont <- crosspred(cb_cont, mod, at = seq(0, 1.2, by = 0.1), cen = 0)

#Prediction effect (Relative humidity)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$humitat_relativa,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_rh$predvar[which.min(pred_rh$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_rh <- crosspred(cb_rh, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)

#Prediction effect (Atmospheric pressure)
predval <- quantile(
  scase_data$pressio_atmosferica,
  probs = (1:99) / 100,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval)

#Minimum RR point
minrr <- pred_pres$predvar[which.min(pred_pres$allRRfit)]

#Prediction effect centered at the minimum RR point
pred_pres <- crosspred(cb_pres, mod, at = predval, cen = minrr)
```
